name: Host services
author: Brett
description: The console parts that run on the VPS host as systemd services (host-service@1, framework/spec/HOST-SERVICES.md): the builds-live publisher, the shipped-features watcher, axHub sync, the agent job runner, the systems check's host checks and Auto fixes, the maintenance actions, and the auto-lander, pipeline and watchdog units, behind one host API on /run/axf-host. Settings → Plugins → Host services shows one row per service (status with since, mode, heartbeat, last run) with Restart, Start, Stop, Run now, its own actions, logs, and the mode control (container → shadow → host) with Roll back; the same list is a panel in the Systems check. Moved plugins show a clear Host service down state (HostServiceGate). Every action is on REST /api/host-services, the MCP tools host_services_*, `axf host …` and voice (host.status, host.restart, host.rollback). The units are installed by deploy/install-host-services.sh; this plugin is only the console's view.

items.description: Drive one host service: do = restart | start | stop | run | run-action (with action and args) | set-mode (with to) | rollback | set-settings (with set). Stop, restart, a confirm action, moving back from host and rollback need confirm: true (they answer confirm_required first).

items.description: Move a service: container → shadow (both run, the host dry-runs and the outputs are compared) → host (the host runs it, the console's copy steps aside). Moving back needs confirm: true. Cut-over is refused until shadow has been quiet long enough with enough clean runs.
